card.name: Stem cell transplant and conditioning text
card.fires_on: Words inside or just before stem cell transplant (HSCT) wording, such as conditioning regimens, busulfan, melphalan, GVHD and VOD. It fires on linking words like of, and, after, in, and for, and on partway-through drug names.

modes.label: Linking words near transplant
modes.description: Small words such as of, and, after or in that sit right before or after transplant terms.
modes.example: VANFLYTA should be stopped 7 days before the start<< of>> a conditioning regimen.

modes.label: Inside transplant drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of transplant-related names such as POTELIGEO or busulfan.
